caption: The drawing depicts a single green glass bottle set against a plain beige background. The bottle has a wide, flat shape with sloping shoulders and a short neck with a pronounced lip. On the front surface of the bottle, the word "UNION" is inscribed in an arc near the upper center, surrounded by a semi-circle of small stars. Below the inscription, within a decorative border resembling a rounded shield, there is an embossed image of two hands shaking. On either side of the central design, there are vertical laurel branches that extend from the base to near the shoulder of the bottle. Beneath the central area, there is an oval-shaped placeholder or cartouche. The green color of the bottle features varying shades, suggesting highlights and shadows that give the object a three-dimensional appearance. The beige background is unadorned, drawing full attention to the bottle itself.
title: Liquor Flask
